diagnosis.summary: Ran the full 20000000-step budget without halting, having produced 5 lines of firmware serial output and 10 boot-log lines. The firmware was running and reporting, so this is either a long-running program that needs a larger budget or an infinite loop / busy-wait on a status bit that never changes (e.g. polling a peripheral the twin does not model).
diagnosis.hint: Re-run with a larger max_steps (try 200000000; the ceiling for this run path is 225000000). Otherwise check for spin-loops that wait on a hardware status bit, and prefer software delay loops over peripheral-flag polls. Consult docs/firmware-scaffolds/README.md for the list of modeled peripherals.
